verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekasaddampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ purisassa cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, itthisaddo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single sound that occupies a man’s mind like the sound of a woman.

verses.pali: Itthisaddo, bhikkhave, purisassa cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
verses.english: The sound of a woman occupies a man’s mind.”
